# UltraChat
**Type:** Measurement instrument  
**Supporting papers:** 16  

## State of the Field

**What it is.** Across the papers, UltraChat is most commonly described as a diverse conversational instruction-following dataset, with one definition specifying that it is multi-turn and generated by GPT-3.5-Turbo. Some papers frame it more by role than by format, treating it as an interactive dialogue benchmark, as a benign dataset for safety-patching evaluation, or as a held-out, out-of-domain setting used to test whether a method generalizes beyond summarization.

**What it is claimed to measure.** Papers use UltraChat to measure three behavioral indicators, Instruction following, Question answering, and Text generation, and one construct, Instruction following ability. The claims are spread across several targets rather than centered on one alone: the most recurring framing is instruction-following, while other papers report it as evaluating question answering or text generation.

**Space of uses.** No other measurement instrument is linked to UltraChat. Papers position it in several ways: as supervised fine-tuning data, as a source of prompts for self-training, as a benign dataset for quantization-assisting and safety-patching evaluation, as an interactive dialogue benchmark, and as a held-out out-of-domain test setting; other work also reports generating outputs from it for chat APIs and instruct LLMs.

## Sources

**UltraChat** (4 papers: [Better Instruction-Following Through Minimum Bayes Risk](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/6756c9f0a1a7c6d1d10ab252f16524f2-Paper-Conference.pdf), [Assessing Safety Risks and Quantization-aware Safety Patching for Quantized Large Language Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v267/main/assets/chen25ci/chen25ci.pdf), [Not All Parameters Are Created Equal: Smart Isolation Boosts Fine-Tuning Performance](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.500.pdf), [MAMM-Refine: A Recipe for Improving Faithfulness in Generation with Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://aclanthology.org/2025.naacl-long.498.pdf))
> A diverse, multi-turn conversational instruction-following dataset generated by GPT-3.5-Turbo, used for supervised fine-tuning and for generating prompts for self-training.
